scope: Post hoc diagnosis of the completed v1 H1/H2 grid; recomputes H<=2 values only; no fitting, no new horizons, no new method evaluation. Not fresh confirmation.
conventions: Conditional estimand; Y = suppressed minus ordinary; zero-based actions; intervention_pair then weight-1 events on the full State; plans checked, never renormalised.

inputs.records_digest_rule: SHA256 of sorted lines '<cell_id> <SHA256 of record bytes>\n'

definitions.m_then_sorted: ordinary rule m at the root, terminal-score sort at the last step: one fixed schedule, whose regret is R0(m)
definitions.hybrid_and_best_hybrid: the best of the six 'm then sorted' schedules chosen per cell in hindsight (minimum R0): an envelope, not a selection policy or a fresh evaluation
definitions.without_fixed_label: the five ordinary rules other than fixed_label: a descriptive sensitivity subset, not a relabelling-invariant class ('ordered' breaks key ties by action ID, 'distance' keeps the LP's pick among tied optima); fixed_label stays in the v1 comparator and the gate is unchanged
definitions.order_class: over each world's adjacent children in key order: 'ordered' if every pair is stochastically ordered; 'atoms' if a failing pair has a same-action atom reversed; else 'weights' (failing pairs have comonotone atoms, so equal weights would be ordered). A pattern, not a causal attribution to geometry or to probability change

allocation_bound.definition: N = max(1, ceil(V / rmse^2)) paired samples for the best ordinary and the oracle variance; the ratio bounds the oracle's sample-count gain only under the assumptions below. Not a measured practical method
assumptions: estimator: average of N independent unbiased paired samples, V known
both couplings in the same admissible class (co-adapted couplings of current states), where the oracle has the least V
equal cost per paired sample and negligible setup cost for both
integer N: small N can turn a variance ratio below 2 into 2:1 (N from 2 to 1)
not_a_bound_on: other estimators, including exact enumeration and Rao-Blackwellisation
methods with different per-pair or setup costs

process_calls.kind: operation counts (derivation), not timings; coupling construction, random draws and LP solves are excluded from the per-pair counts
process_calls.per_pair_rule: 2 intervention updates; per step and world 1 probs call and 1 update (K candidate updates for ordered/distance); 2 terminal scores
process_calls.assumptions: every paired sample rebuilds the intervention pair and each state on its path (no reuse across pairs; reusing shared root work lowers per-pair counts and raises the break-even); break-even compares apply_event counts only; sample counts are the allocation counts, with their assumptions

example_selection: Witnesses: the three maxima named in the brief (selected after v1). Controls: every completed H=2 cell differing from a witness in exactly one of beta, structure (B1<->B2; A2->A1,A3) or alpha, plus the H=1 twin; rule fixed in ALTERNATIVES.md before any diagnostic output.

resources.note: Diagnostic run only (excludes interpreter start-up); not an estimator timing.
